creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp's chat note, 2026-10-23: "text canvas agents can draw or update and a pairing scratchpad". His gloss the same day: a lighter canvas to complement an agent you are running with, probably able to show richer media the way Ghostty or kitty can (images, as through the kitty graphics protocol), not only text.

Today an agent can show something only in its own transcript, or publish a page outside Muster (Lectern). A canvas would sit beside the agent's pane, and the agent would update it through the `muster` CLI as its work moves, a plan or a diagram say, while you edit it too.

Not defined yet: amterp wants to shape it at his computer before anyone designs it. Open: whether it is a kind of pane in the split or something else, what it holds (text, Markdown, images), how an agent writes to it and reads your edits back, and whether it outlives the agent's session.
title: A canvas beside an agent that it writes and updates and you can edit: a pairing scratchpad
